title: 第5章 杨家的未来第6章 赐名修炼
content_zh:
陈阳被杨贯峰随身携带，方便时时刻刻用灵力温养，此时正呆在他的袖子中。
余老一直守着四叶衔灵草，所以这次没有现身。
陈阳看着场间跪拜下的众人，心中十分满意。
杨家如今这个局面，已经是有了崛起之相。
虽说现在还很弱小，但未来只要好好谋划，潜力也是不小。
“起身吧。”
杨贯峰张口，将众人唤起。
随后他的目光便落在了排在众人前方的三个孩子身上，面上立时露出和蔼的笑意。
这三个孩子，便是他之前所提到，杨家的好苗子。
他之所以冒险进入秘境，就是为了能够给这三个孩子提供更好的修炼条件。
虽说杨家如今有他和余老两名聚气中期的修士在，旁人不敢招惹。
但杨贯峰心里清楚，家族想要长远发展最害怕的问题，就是出现断层。
他这一辈中，只有自己有修炼资质，两个弟弟都是普通人，最多也就练练武。
这就导致了现在的杨家，有两名聚气中期的修士，但却没有一个聚气初期。
意识到这点，从坐上家主之位后，杨贯峰便开始鼓励族中各方多生多养，只有子嗣够多，才能以量求质，出现拥有修炼资质的孩子。
杨家的人口也从起初的五十多人，翻了一番到如今的接近百人。
“两位弟弟落座吧，咱们开始今日的议事。”
“是。”
二人应下后，便开始依次汇报族中各类事项。
他们俩没有修炼资质，但却在家族治理中颇有手段。

杨飞云主内，杨霄雷主外，将族中各项事务打理的井井有条，让杨贯峰不用分心，可以专注修炼。
半个时辰过后，二人汇报完毕。
陈阳也从中知晓了杨家目前的基本情况。
杨家在柳叶镇有三条街的商铺，镇外还有一处矿产。
杨姓本族人九十七，加上下人、杂役、护卫等总人口三百余人。
这样的规模，在柳叶镇已经没有任何家族能够企及。
“禀报老祖，今年的王朝税收已经结清，家中余财尚能运作，只是恐怕年底不会有什么盈余。”杨飞云汇报道。
正如他所言，陈阳对这个问题也有几分好奇。
如此多的人口，杨家在这柳叶镇内，还有继续发展下去的空间吗？
从杨飞云口中他得知，世家在王朝治下的城镇中定居，因为享受了王朝的庇护，是要按人口上税的。
并且，要是家族中有修士存在，不但基本人口税收要按比例往上翻，还得追加其他税项，譬如灵晶灵材之类的东西。
content_en:
Chen Yang was carried around by Yang Guanfeng so that he could be warmed by his spiritual power at all times, and he was currently staying in his sleeve.
Mr. Yu has been guarding the four-leaf spiritual grass, so he did not show up this time.
Chen Yang looked at the people kneeling down in the field and felt very satisfied.
In this current situation, the Yang family is already on the rise.
Although it is still very weak now, it has great potential in the future as long as it is planned well.
"Get up."
Yang Guanfeng opened his mouth to wake everyone up.
Then his eyes fell on the three children in front of the crowd, and a kind smile immediately appeared on their faces.
These three children are the good seedlings of the Yang family as he mentioned before.
The reason why he ventured into the secret realm was to provide better training conditions for these three children.
Although there are two monks in the middle stage of Qi Gathering, namely him and Mr. Yu, in the Yang family now, others dare not provoke them.
But Yang Guanfeng knew in his heart that the most feared problem for the family if it wanted to develop in the long run was the emergence of gaps.
Among his generation, he is the only one with the qualifications to practice. His two younger brothers are ordinary people and can only practice martial arts at most.
This has resulted in the current Yang family having two monks who are in the middle stage of Qi gathering, but not one who is in the early stage of gathering Qi.
Realizing this, after taking the position of the head of the family, Yang Guanfeng began to encourage all parties in the clan to have more children and raise more children. Only when there are enough heirs can quality be achieved through quantity, and children with cultivation qualifications can be born.
The population of the Yang family has doubled from more than fifty people at the beginning to nearly a hundred people today.
"Two brothers, please take a seat and let's start today's discussion."
"Yes."
After the two agreed, they began to report on various matters in the clan.
The two of them have no cultivation qualifications, but they are quite capable in family governance.
Yang Feiyun is in charge, and Yang Xiaolei is in charge, and they take care of all the affairs of the clan in an orderly manner, so that Yang Guanfeng does not have to be distracted and can focus on his cultivation.
After half an hour, the two of them finished their report.
Chen Yang also learned about the current basic situation of the Yang family.
The Yang family has three streets of shops in Liuye Town, and there is also a mining property outside the town.
There are ninety-seven members of the Yang clan, including servants, handymen, guards, etc., with a total population of more than three hundred.
No family in Liuye Town can match this scale.
"Reporting to the ancestors, this year's dynasty taxes have been settled, and the family's remaining wealth can still be used, but I'm afraid there won't be any surplus at the end of the year." Yang Feiyunhui reported.
As he said, Chen Yang was also somewhat curious about this issue.
With such a large population, does the Yang family still have room to continue to develop in Liuye Town?
He learned from Yang Feiyun that aristocratic families settled in towns under the dynasty. Because they enjoyed the protection of the dynasty, they had to pay taxes based on their population.
Moreover, if there are monks in the family, not only the basic population tax will be increased proportionally, but other taxes will also have to be added, such as spiritual crystals and spiritual materials.
